source: Cut from five recorded runs’ events.jsonl in uat-runs/ (26 November 2026): 2026-11-23T21-53-37-addressed whole (main at 84bb70fa), 2026-11-11T09-12-47-needsnav, 2026-11-23T18-49-16-holdstill and 2026-11-16T02-17-46-inboxroom (a four-backend run) from their start to the seq given as “until”, and 2026-11-06T03-36-37-scifact to seq 700. Each event keeps its seq and order and only the fields the quiet-stretch readers read (tools/uat/quiet-stretches.mjs, mid-turn-asks.mjs, idle-triggers.mjs): a session’s state, times and need; an item’s id, time, kind and status, a block’s type and title, a person’s message cut to 80 characters; an entry’s source, sender and time; a patch’s status and answer time. A session event that repeats the one before it is dropped. Nothing is added, reordered or retimed. scifact’s “shell” times are when two of @researcher’s recorded shell results arrived in its streams (1793936220506-researcher.jsonl and 1793936352076-researcher.jsonl).
